name: M5.SupportPolynomial.support_degree_bound
statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (K : ℕ), 0 < K → (∀ e ∈ S, e < K) → (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport S).natDegree < K
guidance: Bound degree of the finite sum of X^e. A Finset induction with Polynomial.natDegree_add_le and natDegree_X_pow is a direct route. The empty sum is zero with natDegree zero, so retain K>0 and do not require the polynomial to be nonzero. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
